   - **Offset helpers**: [`lag(val, offset?, default?)`](file:///app/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L241), [`lead(val, offset?, default?)`](file:///app/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L273), [`firstValue(val)`](file:///app/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L305), [`lastValue(val)`](file:///app/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L316), [`nthValue(val, n)`](file:///app/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L327).
   - **Aggregates**: [`windowSum(val)`](file:///app/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L349), [`windowAvg(val)`](file:///app/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L358), [`windowMin(val)`](file:///app/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L367), [`windowMax(val)`](file:///app/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L376), [`windowCount(val?)`](file:///app/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L385).
   - **Frame constructors & boundaries**: [`rows({ from, to })`](file:///app/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L143), [`range({ from, to })`](file:///app/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L154), [`unboundedPreceding`](file:///app/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L93), [`currentRow`](file:///app/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L111), [`unboundedFollowing`](file:///app/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L129), [`preceding(n)`](file:///app/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L98), [`following(n)`](file:///app/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L116).

     - Positional integer arguments (`offset`, `n`, `nth`, frame boundaries) emit as raw SQL literals (`sql.raw(String(n))`) to avoid bound query parameters (even when `0`).
